title: athyrium umbrosum var. tenerum
intro: Athyrium umbrosum var. tenerum, commonly known as Lady-in-hood fern, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the Athyrium genus. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Athyrium umbrosum var. tenerum include treating fever, diarrhea, and skin infections, as well as providing relief from respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
